people.name: Rajat Shah
people.bio: Rajat holds an MBA in Strategy and Finance from the University of Michigan, an MS in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Illinois, and a B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Guwahati. Rajat brings over 26 years of global leadership experience across services, digital transformation, engineering, product development, and business management. Most recently, he served as Vice President - Services at Tetra Pak AB, Sweden, where he led an international team to deploy digital services solutions across global markets. His career spans leadership roles with Tetra Pak, Ingersoll Rand, Subros, Behr and General Motors across Europe, Asia, and North America.

people.name: Rushikesh Kulkarni
people.role: Senior Management Personnel (Chief Growth & Innovation Officer - Industrial Business)
people.bio: Mr. Rushikesh is a global technology and engineering leader and brings over 20+ years of experience at GIC, Eaton, Whirlpool, Honeywell, and Bosch across industrial automation, consumer electronics, embedded systems, connected products, and digital transformation.
